response.rationale: Option B is an 'equivalent' match to the top-ranked leaf, indicating the strongest clinical identity. Options A, D, and C are all 'manifestation_of' matches to the same leaf. Among these, Option A (Right ventricular infarction) is a more specific manifestation than Option D (Acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction due to proximal right coronary artery occlusion), which is more specific than Option C (Acute inferior-lateral ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI)).
